sections.heading: Acquisition Details
paragraphs: According to Foreign Policy Journal, IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) has completed a $1.8 billion acquisition of SkyWater. This transaction adds a chip foundry to IonQ's quantum portfolio. The Motley Fool also reports that IonQ paid $1.8 billion for a chip foundry.

sections.heading: Regulatory Context
paragraphs: WilmerHale reports on the Federal Trade Commission's (FTC) recent review of IonQ and SkyWater. The source discusses the implications this review holds for understanding vertical mergers.
